summary: The Living Knowledge Graph methodology is the tool-agnostic method growmos implements: a repository graph that eats new material, grows by accretion, resolves its own surface forms, answers with citations, measures its health and never forgets. It synthesizes the Anthropic playbook's four stages and agent patterns and adds the write path (remember, link, journal), provisional entities, incremental everything, and an evaluation loop with a ten-item readiness checklist. In agent architectures it is shared memory for orchestrator–workers and the grounding layer for evaluator–optimizer loops.
